title: OGS Resignation Rate by Rank Gap
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ogs:game
| stats avg(resigned_flag) as resignation_rate count as games by rank_gap_bucket
| sort 0 - resignation_rate
description: Ranks rank-gap bucketss by resignation rate.
value: Rank-gap resignation rate shows where confidence or patience breaks first.
implementation: Send resignation rate events to `index=personal` and keep `rank_gap_bucket` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of resignation rate by rank-gap buckets.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which rank-gap bucketss stand out most for resignation rate.
